basics.type: Private university set up by the Punjab State Legislature under the Chitkara University Act
basics.ugc: Recognised under Sections 2(f), 22(1) and 12(B) of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.other: NAAC A+ (CGPA 3.26) awarded in 2021 for five years, up to September 2026

admission: Class 12 with 60% aggregate or 60% in PCM (option 1), or 70% (option 2)
Option 1: JEE Main 2026 All India Rank. Option 2: Class 12 marks. A valid JEE Main score is asked of all B.E. applicants.
B.E. CSE with AI & Future Technologies
Personal interview; Pearson and SAT scores are also accepted

hostel.text: On-campus hostels with furnished rooms, high-speed internet and 24/7 security.

fees.text: Chitkara lists semester-wise fees on each programme page. Ask us for the current fee for your course.
